payload.content: Please assess this 18–34-year-old woman for specialist mental health evaluation and medication management. She is currently taking sertraline 50 mg daily; the indication, treatment response, adherence, adverse effects, and ongoing symptom burden should be reviewed. Please provide diagnostic clarification, assess current safety including suicidal ideation, and advise on whether to continue, adjust, or augment treatment and on appropriate follow-up and psychological therapy options.
